evals.expected_output: Rule count + 10-rule sample at checkpoint 1 (auto-continue allowed in the test), then status counts and a covered list where every rule ID was verified against an installed plugin; no fork yet.

evals.prompt: Run the whole split on the vercel react-best-practices skill (<scratch>/upstream/agent-skills/skills/react-best-practices, name vercel-react-best-practices) into <scratch>/out-2. evals.prompt: Second skill for the same repo: do the split for the composition-patterns skill (<scratch>/upstream/agent-skills/skills/composition-patterns) into the repo from the previous run at <scratch>/out-2 (copy it first).
